topic: Prompt of the week: the fine-print reader (after a week of AI news hidden in the fine print)
post:
This week's biggest AI news was hiding in the fine print. 🔎
Here's a prompt that reads it for you.

Two examples from the last few days 👇
📄 Google's updated privacy policy added an exception: Gmail, Drive and Photos data you connect to its AI features can help shape your ads
📊 Anthropic's IPO filing spelled out big compute commitments and risks in its risk-factor section

Most of us never read documents like these. AI can help, as long as you ask the right way.

Prompt of the week 👇
"Here's a document [privacy policy / terms / contract / filing]. Explain it to me in plain English:
1. The 5 things that matter most for someone like me
2. Anything that changed or is unusual
3. What I'm agreeing to, and what I can opt out of
Quote the exact sentence for each point, so I can check it."

The magic line is the last one ✅
Asking for exact quotes lets you verify every point yourself.

Why it matters:
The AI shift is being written into terms and filings, not just product launches. Reading the fine print is now a career skill. 🧠

Practical takeaway:
Run this prompt on one terms update in your inbox this weekend. 📝

What's the last fine print you actually read? 👇

Follow for daily AI news you can actually use.
